Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompaniesthis order exists between,
Mrs. A. L. S. Dissanayake, No. 22, Peter's Lane, Dehiwala. of the one part
and
Sri Lanka - Libya Agricultural and Livestock Development Company Limited, 3rd Floor, 'Lanlib' Building, No. 46/56, NawamMawatha, Colombo 02. of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, Wijeyadasa Rajapaksha, Minister of Justice and Labour Relations do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts,Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. V.Virithamulla, No. 128, Pirivena Road, Boralesgamuwa to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.

Colombo.

Mrs. A. L. S. Dissanayake, No. 22, Peter's Lane, Dehiwala of the one part
and
Sri Lanka - Libya Agricultural and Livestock Development Company Limited, 3rd Floor, 'Lanlib' Building, No. 46/56, NawamMawatha, Colombo 02 of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the non-granting of payments for water, electricity, telephone, medical bills etc. from January 2007 to December 2008 and non -granting of payments for rent allowance, entertainment allowance etc. from February 2008 to September 2008 which had been paid inaddition to the salary to Mrs. A. L. S. Dissanayake who worked at the Sri Lanka Libya Agricultural and Livestock Development CompanyLimited is just, and if not so. to what reliefs she is entitled.
HERATH YAPA,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 23rd day of February, 2015.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation of Order under Section 4(1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon(Revised Edition 1956), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-SpecialProvisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 dated 13.10.2014 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka,Extraordinary No. 1887/6 of 03.11.2014 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner ofLabour dated 04.10.2014 between,
Inter Company Employees' Union, No. 115-D, Kalapaluwawa Road, Koswatta, Talangama (on behalf of Mr. T. A. M.Priyantha) of the one part
and
Lanka Electricity Company (Private) Ltd, E. H. Cooray Building, No. 411, Galle Road, Colombo 03 of the other part
was referred to Mrs. Kanthi Sri Devi Ranasinghe for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order by revoked, I Wijeyadasa Rajapaksha, Minister of Justice and LabourRelations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 13.10.2014.
WIJEYADASA RAJAPAKSHA,Minister of Justice and Labour Relations.
Colombo,12th March, 2015.

and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05 of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matters in dispute between the aforesaid parties are

I. Whether Mr. A. W. N. Harischandra Waduge who had been working at the Chilaw Depot of the Sri Lanka Transport Board andworking at the Puttalam Depot at present after being transferred is entitled to receive arrears in salary from 28.10.2010 to17.01.2011 the period during which his service was interdicted due to the disciplinery inquiry against him, and if so, to what reliefshe is entitled.

II. Whether Mr. A. W. N. Harischandra Waduge has been caused injustice by the punishments imposed on him after the disciplineryinquiry against him, and if such injustice has been caused, to what reliefs he is entitled.
HERATH YAPA,Commissioner of Labour.
